en.tagline: Logs corrections and reflections into local memory tiers
en.summary: This skill lets an agent review its own work and record what it learns. Corrections, explicit preferences and self-reflection notes are stored in local files under ~/self-improving/. Stored patterns move between hot, warm and cold tiers based on how often they are used.
problem: An agent often makes the same mistake again in a later session. A user may correct the same thing several times, and the lesson is lost when the session ends.

With this skill, corrections go to corrections.md and explicit preferences go to memory.md. A lesson is promoted only after repeated use, and the agent loads only the small hot file by default, with other files loaded when the context matches.
fit: Users who correct the agent often and want it to remember the fix
Long-running projects with repeated style or workflow rules
Work where you want a readable log of what the agent has learned
unfit: Cases where you expect the agent to infer preferences from silence or observation, which the skill never does
steps: On first use, the agent runs setup.md if ~/self-improving/ does not exist.
When the user corrects the agent or a command fails, the agent logs the entry in corrections.md.
Explicit preferences such as "Always do X for me" are added to memory.md, which is capped at 100 lines and always loaded.
After significant work, the agent writes a short CONTEXT, REFLECTION and LESSON entry.
A pattern used 3 times in 7 days is promoted to HOT, and unused patterns are demoted to WARM after 30 days and archived to COLD after 90 days.
Nothing is deleted without asking first, and "memory stats" and "export memory" let you inspect or back up the files.

zh.tagline: 记录纠正与反思，分层保存本地记忆
zh.summary: 这个技能让智能体回顾自己的工作，并记录它学到的内容。用户纠正、明确的偏好和自我反思的记录都保存在 ~/self-improving/ 下的本地文件中。已保存的规律会根据使用频率在热、温、冷三层之间移动。
problem: 智能体在之后的会话中常常重复同样的错误。用户可能多次纠正同一件事，而会话结束后这些经验就丢失了。
使用这个技能后，纠正记录写入 corrections.md，明确的偏好写入 memory.md。只有经过反复使用，经验才会提升为长期规则。智能体默认只加载体积较小的热记忆文件，其他文件在上下文匹配时再加载。
fit: 经常纠正智能体、希望它记住修正结果的用户
有重复风格或工作流规则的长期项目
希望能看到智能体学到了什么的工作场景
unfit: 没有后续跟进的一次性任务
期望智能体从沉默或观察中推断偏好的场景，而这个技能从不这样做
steps: 首次使用时，如果 ~/self-improving/ 不存在，智能体会运行 setup.md。
用户纠正智能体或命令失败时，智能体把记录写入 corrections.md。
“以后都为我这样做”之类的明确偏好会写入 memory.md。该文件上限为 100 行，且始终加载。
完成较重要的工作后，智能体写下简短的 CONTEXT、REFLECTION 和 LESSON 记录。
7 天内使用 3 次的规律会提升到热层；未使用的规律在 30 天后降到温层，90 天后归档到冷层。
删除任何内容前都会先询问。“memory stats”和“export memory”可用于查看统计或导出备份。
